newsitem.title: CANADA: Falconbridge to issue 8.0 mln units at C$10.
newsitem.headline: Falconbridge to issue 8.0 mln units at C$10.

text.p: Falconbridge Ltd said on Friday it will issue 8,000,000 units priced at C$10.00 each, with each unit consisting of one cumulative preferred share Series 1 and one cumulative preferred share Series 2 purchase warrant.
Falconbridge said the Series 1 shares will pay, if declared, a quarterly cumulative dividend of C$0.1563 per share until August 31, 1998 to yield 6.25 percent.
The first of such dividends would be payable on June 1, 1997 and will be C$0.1443 per share based on the anticipated issue date of March 7, 1997.

After September 1, 1998 the quarterly cash dividend will be reduced to C$0.02 per share. The Series 1 shares are redeemable by Falconbridge, in whole or in part, at any time on or after March 1, 2004 at C$10.00 per share plus any declared and unpaid dividends to the date of redemption.

On September 1, 1998, December 1, 1998 and March 1, 1999, each holder of Series 1 share will have the right to acquire a cumulative preferred share Series 2 by tendering for conversion one Series 1 share and exercising one warrant together with a cash payment of C$15.00.
The Series 2 shares will pay, if declared, a quarterly cumulative dividend of C$0.3669 per share on the first day of June, September, December and March until March 1, 2004 to yield 5.875 percent.

From March 1, 2004 the Series 2 shares will pay, if declared, a quarterly cumulative dividend payable on the 12th day of each month with the annual floating dividend rate in the first month equal to 85 percent of the prime lending rate. Thereafter, the dividend rate will be tied to the prime lending rate and will be raised or lowered on a monthly basis based on the trading price of the Series 2 shares.

Falconbridge said at the option of the holder, the Series 2 shares are convertible into an equal number of cumulative preferred shares Series 3 on March 1, 2004 and on each five year anniversary thereafter. At the option of the holder, the Series 3 shares are convertible into an equal number of Series 2 shares on March 1, 2009 and on each five-year anniversary thereafter.
The Series 3 shares will have a miniumum dividend rate of 80 percent of the then current yield on five-year Government of Canada bonds.
The Series 2 shares will not be redeemable by Falconbridge prior to March 1, 2004. On that date they will be redeemable in whole but not in part for C$25.00.
The Series 2 shares will be redeemable by Falconbridge at any time after March 1, 2004, in whole but not it part, for C$25.50 plus accrued and unpaid dividends to the redemption date.
On March 1, 2009 and on each five-year anniversary thereafter, the Series 2 and Series 3 shares will be redeemable by Falconbridge, in whole but not in part, for C$25.00.
